rules.scope: distinct EN terms occurring in at least 3 documents
rules.stable: one MK variant with at least 4 supporting documents and 5 total occurrences
rules.variant: multiple MK variants with dominant variant frequency at least 75%
rules.conflict: multiple MK variants with dominant variant frequency below 75%
rules.low_evidence: fewer than 5 total occurrences or fewer than 4 supporting documents
